title: Lifecycle Management for Claude 3.5 Haiku
business: Enterprises maintaining legacy AI integration layers.
problem: Applications relying on the retired claude-3-5-haiku-20241022 model face service interruptions as requests to retired models will fail.
solution: The organization must perform an audit of API usage to identify instances of the retired model and migrate workloads to active, supported replacements like claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.
steps: Navigate to the Usage page in the Claude Console to audit current model deployments.
Export the usage CSV to identify all API keys and endpoints currently invoking claude-3-5-haiku-20241022.
Update application code to reference the recommended replacement model, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.
Conduct thorough testing of the application with the new model to ensure functional parity before full production deployment.
outcome: Restoration of service reliability and compliance with Anthropic's model lifecycle support policies.
limitation: The primary trade-off is the potential for behavioral drift between model versions; developers must verify output consistency through regression testing after migration.
